title: General.
officialText:
The building areas limited by Table 503 shall be permitted to be increased due to frontage (I ) and automatic sprinkler f system protection (I ) in accordance with the following: s

A = [A + (A × If) + (A × I )] (Equation 5-1) a t t t s where: A = Allowable building area per story (square feet). a A = Tabular building area per story in accordance with Table 503 (square feet). t

If = Area increase factor due to frontage as calculated in accordance with Section 506.2.

I = Area increase factor due to sprinkler protection as calculated in accordance with Section 506.3. s
